headline: Lambiase misses Qatar, Tom Hart engineers Verstappen
body: Gianpiero Lambiase will not work with Max Verstappen this weekend because of personal circumstances. Tom Hart takes the race engineer role, and Red Bull expects Lambiase back for Abu Dhabi.

headline: Honda finds no fault with Alonso's engine after Las Vegas
body: Honda says data and maintenance checks showed no issue with the engine Fernando Alonso reported as broken before he pitted on the penultimate lap in Las Vegas. It will check how the engine runs at Lusail on Friday.
